news.title: Who will control the US Senate in 2026? Nine races to watch
news.description: Nine US Senate races are emerging as critical contests for party control. Democrats see an opening as President Trump's approval ratings weaken significantly. North Carolina, Maine, Michigan, and Ohio offer the clearest paths to a Democratic majority. Alaska, Iowa, and Texas could become essential if the party loses ground elsewhere. These contests will shape the chamber's composition for the upcoming legislative session.
